reasons: .github/workflows/ci.yml: the file defines or carries out the workflow and its gate
scripts/verify-workflow.conf: an existing check or line is changed or removed
explanation: Issue #492: The template's pull requests run the workflow self-tests only when a file under paths: changed (step 3 of #468). The merge of this feature needs the owner's approval for the reasons listed; the approval is the owner's review of the pull request on GitHub, bound to the commit by GitHub. This request asks and records; it grants nothing.
